# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _cells(student):
    if not student.email:
        raise ProjectError(f"No email for {student.display_name}")
    return (student.display_name, student.section, student.email)


def contact_rows(students):
    """Text rows sorted by name, with aligned columns."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("No students to list")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    table = [_cells(item) for item in ordered]
    widths = [max(len(row[col]) for row in table) for col in range(3)]
    return [_pad(row, widths) for row in table]


def _pad(row, widths):
    cells = [text.ljust(size) for text, size in zip(row, widths)]
    return "  ".join(cells).rstrip()
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Zed", "Al", "B2", "al@x.org"),
            Student("1", "Abe", "Bo", "A1", "bo@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Abe, Bo  A1  bo@x.org",
            "Zed, Al  B2  al@x.org"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Abe, Bo"):
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Abe", "Bo", "A1")])

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
